title: Large bushfire threatens homes and properties on Flinders Island off Tasmania
summary_full: Blaze spreads significantly across the north of Flinders Island after being started by lightning strikesGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastHomes and properties on a picturesque remote island were under threat on Wednesday night from an out-of-control bushfire that had sent smoke hundreds of kilometres south.The blaze on Flinders Island in Bass Strait spread significantly on Wednesday after being started by lightning strikes.
